question: On the frozen credential-free GET-only 20-host/556-item frame, against measured same-host BFS cost, does revalidating a persisted deep path (fresh GETs/bytes for liveness+change detection, scaling with hop and elapsed time) plus any session-scale stale-replay false-accepts undercut cold re-derivation, and at what break-even hop/elapsed time does persistence stop paying?
hypothesis: For the 208 admitted deep state-carrying items, revalidation cost (including change detection and liveness probes) plus bounded session-scale stale-replay cost is < cold re-derivation cost over some non-empty window ladder (0, 300, 900, 1800 s); persistence becomes uneconomic above break-even hop/elapsed time and/or if revalidation cost >= re-derivation cost across all measured windows with sufficient power.
falsifier: Persistence is not economically justified on this frame: (a) revalidation cost >= cold re-derivation cost for all windows in the ladder with measurement valid, OR (b) the measured stale-replay false-accept rate cannot be bounded without day-scale span (structurally undecidable) so no trustworthy false-accept contribution can be claimed, OR (c) measurement fails (infrastructure/representation) before a discriminating decision.

baselines.description: Cold same-host BFS re-derivation cost from frozen frame; comparator per admitted deep item. Source: EXP-FRONTIER-38184956362 (in-frame measured).

distribution_ref.notes: ordinal min 31, max 250, mean 166.0 over 208 items

expected.ceiling_effect_risk: medium; must not assume replay speedup

baselines.description: Naive exact-path replay of a persisted deep path without revalidation (legacy guard). Used only to demonstrate replay alone is not assumed cheap; not treated as the economic answer.

expected.notes: Honor P2-REPLAY-COST guard: ~1.002x on matched tasks; treat as control/guard, not treatment.

positive_control.description: If a persisted path with bounded revalidation undercuts cold BFS at some window while change-detection/liveness remain measurable and false-accepts bounded, treatment outperforms cold baseline.
positive_control.criterion: persistence_econ.undercuts_cold == true for at least one window in {0,300,900,1800}s with valid measurement

null_control.description: Revalidation cost >= cold re-derivation cost across all windows (persistence uneconomic) or measurement structurally undecidable for false-accept claim.
null_control.criterion: all windows: reval_cost >= cold_cost - delta_eq (or equivalent) and no discriminating break-even

prerequisites: Frozen frame artifacts accessible and hashes match (structural.jsonl from parent frame; 20/20 seeds HTTP 200)
Credential-free GET-only stdlib HTTP; no model key/browser required
Baseline B-COLD-SAME-HOST-BFS available (parent metrics/ledger) for the same 208 admitted items
Can measure GET counts, bytes, elapsed per probe; session-scale timing controllable
Liveness/change detection signal measurable without requiring day-scale span; false-accept measurement bounded to session-scale regime only

controls.description: Re-verify frame identity against frozen hashes from parent (structural.jsonl sha256 from EXP-FRONTIER-38184956362) for the item set used.
controls.pass_if: hash match and item count matches 208 admitted deep items

controls.description: Cold BFS cost per item available for all 208 items; no NA introduced.
controls.pass_if: cold_cost present for every admitted item; mean/median consistent with 166.0±tolerance

controls.description: Revalidation probes can detect liveness and a controlled change for at least a small calibration set; change detection fires on synthetic modification and not spuriously.
controls.pass_if: calibration passes with false positive/negative within declared bounds or explicitly reports measurement failure

controls.description: If false-accept rate is estimated, it must be bounded to session-scale regime; do not extrapolate to day-scale hazard. If cannot be bounded, record as measurement limitation (not negative science).
controls.pass_if: false_accept_regime == 'session' or 'not_measurable' with justification; no day-scale extrapolation

controls.description: HTTP budget bounded; do not exceed declared budget; respect retry/backpressure; count bytes/GETs/elapsed.
controls.pass_if: total GETs/bytes within declared ceiling; no unaccounted fetches

validity_threats: JS-rendered search pages may affect some channel probes (inherited scope boundary; parent frame already characterized)
Single-vantage egress (inherited; cross-vantage not required by mandate but reproducibility caveat)
Day-scale staleness hazard structurally undecidable on committed corpora (legacy program) - must not claim freshness detector
Construct 'state-carrying' items include chrome in some classes (pre-registered) - use the frozen admitted set
Ceiling/floor risk: if revalidation approaches zero overhead or if cold costs collapse, need sensitivity; frame gives diversity (min 31, max 250)

primary.description: Economic comparison: for each window w in {0,300,900,1800}, compute persistence break-even vs cold BFS. Persistence pays if reval_cost_w + delta_false_accept_w < cold_cost_i (per item or aggregated) over a decisive majority with valid measurement; report break-even hop/elapsed.
primary.statistic: break-even analysis (per-item and stratified by hop class), with confidence intervals where feasible; effect size in absolute cost (GETs/bytes/s) and relative.
primary.min_effect: >= 10% relative reduction in mean cost OR >= 5 GETs absolute, whichever larger (pragmatic, declared)

outcome_mapping.SUPPORTS: any window shows persistence pays with min_effect and measurement valid
outcome_mapping.FALSIFIES: no window shows persistence pays (reval_cost >= cold_cost across all windows) with measurement valid; or structurally cannot bound false-accepts as required
outcome_mapping.MIXED: pays for some stratification (e.g. deep hop>h0, short elapsed) but not others

product_consequence_positive: If persistence pays, invest in persisted inherited-path store with revalidation policy (liveness+change detection) gated by hop/elapsed break-even; feeds C-FRESHNESS/C-PRODUCT-ECON with explicit economics.
product_consequence_negative: If persistence does not pay across measured windows, do not build general persisted-path cache for deep state-carrying items on this substrate class; redirect to cold re-derivation or different compression; PARK persistence subthread (no discovery rerun).

estimated_cost.notes: Bounded by 208 items * (revalidation probes) * windows + calibration; reuse frozen frame; no LLM endpoint needed.

expected_information_gain: high if break-even exists (changes build decision); medium even if negative (prevents wasted work).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Decision branches (SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES/MIXED/INCONCLUSIVE) are well-defined; baselines and windows specified.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Parent frozen frame accessible; BFS baseline exists for 208 items; GET/bytes/elapsed measurable with stdlib HTTP.

baseline_identifiability.reason: B-COLD-SAME-HOST-BFS stable id and distribution reference from parent; naive replay included as guard.

control_sensitivity.reason: MC-LIVENESS-CHANGE-DETECT + MC-SESSION-SCALE-BOUND provide sensitivity; calibration set required.

treatment_liveness.reason: No SPIDER treatment arm that requires kernel modification or new execution engine; this is a measurement/economics experiment using frozen frame and stdlib HTTP probes.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: Only frozen frame artifacts and parent metrics/ledgers are interpretation dependencies; listed in freeze_artifacts.

freeze_artifacts.notes: Frozen frame (sha256 from parent); defines hosts/items set
Contains baseline BFS path cost distribution for admitted items
Admitted deep items (208) with per-channel membership/liveness
Parent outcome context (bounded negative) - do not re-measure discovery
